sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Watchguard calibration failure: the control could not perform a pressure switch calibration. This is a 1-hour soft lockout.
causes: Unable to perform pressure switch calibration
diySteps: With the furnace off, look at the outdoor intake and exhaust terminations for snow, ice, leaves or a nest. Do not take the vent apart. Wait for the 1-hour soft lockout to end before judging a new call
Technician: check the vent system and the pressure switch wiring connections. The code clears when calibration has finished successfully
proAdvice: E276 is the watchguard calibration failure with a 1-hour soft lockout. E228 is the calibration-failure row that does not use that lockout sentence. Do not jumper a pressure switch. Call a licensed HVAC technician if the terminations are clear and the code returns.
